build_vision_encoder: build a vision encoder (CLIP ViT, Swin, or DeiT) from config with optional pretrained weight loading
build_text_encoder: build a text encoder (BERT or RoBERTa) from config with optional MLM pretraining support
create_xvlm_model: create an XVLM model instance with contrastive and matching losses for vision-language alignment
load_pretrained_weights: load pretrained vision and text encoder weights from checkpoint with position embedding interpolation
compute_contrastive_loss: compute distributed contrastive loss between normalized image and text features
